reviews.text: If your looking for the perfect groom look no further, the girls at the pet palace are so lovely and caring, thanks so much pet palace we’re always happy with coco she always looks and smells amazing ❤️
Great service appointment for Rona was within an hour of me popping in. Really pleased with her cut.
Amazing service every time

Alice was wonderful with bailey. 2nd time he's been now. His cut has had compliments from people when I'm waking him. He smells divine and looks like such a handsome boy. We are and will be returning customers
Took my rocksy for a full groom coz she got herself in a bit of state in the garden and they were absolutely amazing she came home looking stunning 🥰🥰🥰 …

First time using here for my Maine coon who is nervous and this was his first groom.....well what can I say amazing experience and he has come out beautiful. I love how all the staff got involved with his first groom and I am a very happy cat mommy

Having been to two other groomers I was unsure but the reviews were very good and I can honestly say The Pet Palace deserves those good reviews and far more than just five stars ... they were lovely...everything about them and every one there ... and they were sooooo good with my 'spicy at home' cat ... they even had him head butting loving them ... unheard of!! Thank you so much ... I will be back ... please stay there and never change!! Highly highly highly recommended!!

Brought my two dogs in they had a lovely groom and I learnt a lot more about them as my family thought they was aggressive with other dogs. One of the dogs has ear problems and rarely lets anyone touch his ears but he allowed Tracey to clean them
My dog Indi as been too the pet place twice  the staff are really lovely and they listen too my worry’s about Indi and are very helpful Indi loves it there I would not go no we’re ellse

Olive is feeling refreshed, revived and ready for summer with her fresh groom. We have always had excellent service at the Pet Palace and I would highly recommend. A very relaxed and calm atmosphere and very professional groomers.

Coco - from the moment I met the team at Pet Palace I knew they would look after my little dog, she’d had a bad experience at a previous dog grooming salon and we’d been trying to cut her ourselves as we didn’t know where to go.  They put me at ease straight away, allowed me to share my concerns and worked with me to ensure Coco was completely at ease before the first wash and cut.  She played outside beforehand and looks amazing.  Thankyou to the team! it is clear you love animals and just want the best for them and the owners.  I would highly recommend!! Thankyou Dawn Xx
Amazing never had a bad groom from them 100% recommendations

Excellent service
Kind, friendly and welcoming to the customers and their owners
Very gentle with my beloved cat Libby
Will definately use The Pet Palace again...thanks guys
Vicki
Excellent service. My dog came back smelling great
I took my ragdoll cat, Nova, for her first groom today. The staff were wonderful and so attentive to Nova. I couldn’t recommend The Pet Palace highly enough.
Such lovely staff xx made my cat Mai feel very welcomed and looked after, she enjoyed! Reasonably priced and did a wonderful job with the grooming. We definitely come back regularly x

Absolutely love this place.
The girls are amazing and my fosters have been so well cared for. Even big hairy Reggie came back looking very handsome and smelling gorgeous 😍 …

We brought our two guinea pigs in to be groomed. We couldn't find any where local to do this but the Pet Palace were great and worth the travel. They got us in that same weekend and were very reasonably priced. My boys look lovely and smell gorgeous. One of the guinea pigs is long haired and needed alot of tlc and The Pet Palace did an amazing job. Thank you!

Absolutely amazing work from the staff here. They really do look after your pets and make sure that they are looking absolutely the best! I really do recommend this place to anyone with a pet not just for the groom but also for their amazing natural treats selection they have.
absolutely amazing groomers friendly staff and great with animals 10/10 service
Amazing experience!!
Fantastic staff, lovely atmosphere and lovely grooming

My 2 gsd attenting the grooming in the Pet Palace and can't complain, especially where both are quite loud (lol gsd for you) They always smell fresh for weeks. At least I don't need to do nails (hate it myself)

Food is great my 2 dogs love the raw and dry.

Defo good place to take your doggo 😉

Ps. They even got prezzies for Christmas 😘

I’ve been coming to the pet palace since it opened and I would not trust anyone else with my girl.

Alice and her team are fantastic and Naala always comes back home happy, fresh and clean.

The shop is always well stocked with pet food, treats and accessories the grooming area is spotless and has a lovely calming environment.

We will see you soon for Naala’s next groom!

Helped get the right care for my pet chihuahua called Dadyal Kashmiri - hes looking and smelling great again!

Being from alum rock, dadyal kashmiri was  rolling about in all kinds of litter and poop and mess all over the place and his hair looked terrible

The pet palace made my little dadyal kashmiri look like a prince again and smell like a king

Thank you so much

Words cannot express our deepest gratitude for all of you wonderful ladies for the AMAZING groom you did for our two Chows. Roxy has never been so happy in a groomers as she was with you all. Sorry for Charlie soaking you!
See you all in the new year! Merry Christmas 🎅 …

Took my British Blue cat for a groom and nail trim, I would highly recommend, his fur is amazing and smells beautiful and his nails clipped without too much fuss. We will be regulars, excellent service.
So glad I found you!! First time easy n quick booking, great service, price amazing! Cant thank you enough! Even gave my dog a bandana n gift set, above n beyond x
Couldn’t recommend a better place my English bulldog rolo suffers with skin problems + allergies but since coming here his skin has stayed amazing and smells amazing

What an exceptional place!
The team here are incredibly caring and considerate of the animals.

I've taken both of my dogs here, and my one dog is fear aggressive and the team did so well with him. He's not the kind of dog who likes being touched, so has never been groomed before now (he's 7y/o). The team worked wonders on him, definitely dog whisperers.

I honestly can't recommend and thank The Pet Palace team enough!!! They also have an amazing selection of treats and food for your beloved pets. They really do want the best for our animals.

Always parking available which is an added bonus.
Thank you to Tracy for the care and attention for my kittens first groom! Catty enjoyed herself and is smelling and looking fabulous.

We were looking for somewhere to take our two guinea pigs to be groomed, not many places near us, but Pet Palace staff helped us out and done a great job, both piggy's came back groomed and smelling lovely,  I will be going regularly now to ensure perfect piggy care..
Under new ownership as of ~6 months ago. The new owners are amazing! Very passionate with a great attention to detail.

I was thoroughly impressed with the dog grooming service provided by Pet Palace. Securing a next-day appointment was quick and convenient, requiring just a £10 deposit online, with the remaining balance settled after the session. The grooming itself was of exceptional quality—my dog has never smelt so good. The staff were warm, friendly, and made us feel very welcome. I’ll definitely be booking again. Highly recommended.

Both our dogs love going to see the ladies at The Pet Palace, they are so well cared for and definitely are treated like a couple of princes’. Both dogs have always seemed to be so nervous when they have been groomed elsewhere in the past but no longer is this true. They both come out as if they have had a wonderful time and are full of beans. Lovely welcoming team and an oasis of pets treats. Definitely a hidden gem. 💎

STAFF WHERE SO LOVELY AND APPEAR TO ENJOY THEIR WORK WITH THE DOGS AND THE MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC. MUCH MUCH BETTER THAN THE LAST GROOMERS I WENT TO.
THANK YOU LADYS
FROM LUNA (LABRADOODLE PUPPY)

I've used these guys a few times my dogs love them especially Bella I took my little marshmallow in today for her 1st groom and let me say the girls had their hands full as she showed her sassy attitude but the girls where really patient with her and gave her cuddles along the way.

And they also have some amazing little surprises treat bags for only a pound so I had to get loads for my doggos but there's some left I thought this was a really good idea thank you for our amazing experience as always 😊

Fantastic service here , my fur baby’s groom was lovely and she was so content and happy with these lovely ladies .
Also they helped with giving tips on my fussy eater and she’s now eating so well !
Their food range in shop is great with lots of natural treats that my little lady loves !
Thankyou guys 5*

Amazing groomers.. I took my poodle to them as he was in desperate need of a bath and cut after a long active holiday and my regular groomer having no availability. He looked stunning when I collected him and more importantly he was soo happy and bouncy so I knew they really showed him some love whilst they had him.. I will definitely be booking in with pet palace again ☺️

I have had my dog for 14 years and bringing her here has been her best grooming experience in 14 years. She is usually very anxious, does not like water & hates her nails being clipped. The ladies here were so gentle and accomdedating to her. They even let my partner & I watch the process for peace of mind. We will deffinently be bringing her back and feel comftable to leave her in their care. They are better than pets at home & vet services we have previously used. My dog left with a spring in her step, she seemed happy! Great Job Pet Palace Team!!

Fantastic service. Took my dog on Friday and they did a fantastic job of grooming for my cocker spaniel. Really good service with fantastic friendly staff. The dog loved the service and came out really happy and looking better than he did before.
Amazing with my dog and very friendly and gave me some very helpful advise regarding my dogs nails

Brought my westie Monty in for his first groom here, and with him being diabetic and blind I was slightly worried how he'd react to an unfamiliar place/people. The girls at the groomers were brilliant with him and made sure he was well looked after, I even got a couple of videos as a little check in on how he's doing. He came out looking absolutely gorgeous and smelling amazing! I'll definitely be bringing him back in.

Thank you so very much. I have to say how pleased I am with the groom and care my 2 little cross chihuahuas had today. They both had a full groom. They came back just as I asked for, looking amazing, smelling wonderful and most of all …

Just picked up by boy jenson from this grooming salon. He has come back looking absolutely gorgeous. Smells amazing and the cut is very professionally done.. and most of all he is a very happy pup. Highly recommend. Thanks guys

Great service. Really friendly people. My dog smelt amazing after his groom. They also have a great variety of dog foods including raw & dry food. The dog beds and accessories in there are great too. Everything under one roof. Thanks again !
Great service for my anxious elderly dog

First time using Amira’s pet Palace, dropped off our Westie puppy for his first proper cut, as he so still so young, they had to just use scissors, and did a great job! Will definitely using Amira’s from now on.
